decision: Selected the centroid of Bexar County parcel 1350409 (geo ID 16623-007-0010; NCB 16623 (SA South) Block 7 Lot 1; owner Amazon Data Services Inc, mailed to PO Box 80416, Seattle WA 98108; situs 12807 Donop Rd, San Antonio 78223; 48.901 geodesic acres) as the campus locator for the AWS ALE061 / Bitter Blue data-centre property. The TxGIO 9-1-1 address point for 12807 Donop Rd and both City of San Antonio permit geocodes used for this address fall inside it. It locates the Amazon property that holds existing Building 1/A and the permitted Building 2/B, not the footprint of Building 2.

computed.crs: EPSG:4326 as served (wkid 4326); areas and distances on the WGS84 ellipsoid (pyproj Geod)
computed.neighbours: Envelope identify (lon -98.400 to -98.380, lat 29.284 to 29.300; 213 parcels): 1350409 is the only parcel owned by an Amazon-named entity. It adjoins parcel 157629 (2020 FI Nabors LLC, CB 4007-6 P-310; 24.228 acres; a 0.007-acre sliver overlaps in the snapshot) and 1197894 (a Donop Rd lot of another owner); 2020 FI Nabors LLC also holds the 128.8-acre parcel 157568 to the north. The Nabors parcels are not part of the locator.

verification_script: scratchpad ctx4 geom_ale061.py and parcel_overlap.py (pyproj 3.7.1, shapely 2.1.1), run with uv run --no-project
